Question [id 200]:
The passage states that Hindi and Urdu are "similar in vocabulary but different in script". Therefore, statement B ("They differ in script") is true. Statement A contradicts the text ("usually understand each other"). Statement C is false (script differs). Statement D is false (vocabulary similar).

Question [id 201]:
The passage explains that the King originally named the alphabet "Hunmin Jeongeum". It is later referred to as "Hangeul". Thus, the name was changed to Hangeul. Answer B.

Question [id 202]:
The passage explicitly states: "Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy." Answer D.

Question [id 203]:
The passage notes the crust is "100 km thick on the far side" and "thicker under the highlands". It is thinner under the maria. Therefore, the thickest point is under the highlands. Answer C.

Question [id 204]:
The passage identifies the Amazon as the "second longest". Option C states it is "the longest", which is not attributed in the text. Answers A, B, and D are supported by the text. Answer C.

Question [id 205]:
The passage states "Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector". This is the largest proportion compared to industry (a quarter) and agriculture (a fifth). Answer A.

Question [id 206]:
The passage says the reactor is working to "make energy in the same way" (as stars). Thus, it creates energy. Answer D.

Question [id 207]:
The passage explicitly states "Italy's main goals were African countries." This corresponds to capturing African countries. Answer A.

{"answers": {"200": "B", "201": "B", "202": "D", "203": "C", "204": "C", "205": "A", "206": "D", "207": "A"}}
